snippet.title: Announcing Twin Shot Deluxe - Coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch!
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618520/TwinShotDeluxe/

The Angel Cats are BACK! Twin Shot Deluxe is a platform arcade shooter where players defend their homeland using bow and arrows. Take aim at 200+ brand new levels set across four worlds. Play solo or with a friends in local co-op (1-4 players) or competitively to see who will be crowned champion.

- Add to your Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618520/TwinShotDeluxe/
- Coming soon to the Nintendo Switch!

WHATS NEW?
- 20FPS The game now runs at an angelic 60FPS.
- Massively improved controls that still feel like you remember, Improved air control (✓), Stop on a dime(✓), Coyote time (✓), Variable jump (✓).
 - Modern 16:9 ratios, that's 78% more Twin Shot.
- Join friends and family in multiplayer (1-4 players) with Controller and keyboard support
- A Complete graphical overhaul: All backgrounds, characters, animation and menus have been remastered!
- 200+ all new levels built from the ground up.
- Take aim at 2 brand new formidable bosses.
- New music tracks by the games original composer Dave Cowen
- Prepare to hum along to the iconic earworm tracks with music now uncompressed and crystal clear.
- Brand new cinematic intro and ending illustrations.
- Unlock the new Atlantis theme with exciting new enemies and mechanics to enjoy across its 50 stages.
- Cheats and Treats are BACK! Unlock a plethora of new character skins, abilities and modes for enhanced replay.
- Introducing HATS! Battle amongst your friends or alone to see who will be crowned champion. Hats aren't just hilariously cosmetic but also come with additional buffs.
- Tag mode: Dial up the competitiveness to 11 in tag mode. Tag other players with and arrow and claim the prized hat for yourself. A real game of Angel Cat and Mouse.

The good ol' days of carefree gaming are back. Twin Shot Deluxe is our first release in the Nitrome Classics series. We are bringing back beloved games of old re-equipped for modern gamers.
Look out for more Nitrome Classics games in the near future. 

Re-live your childhood and complete your collection!
